# GCVE Directory Files

This repository contains the directory files managed by the [GCVE allocation system](https://gcve.eu/).

The files are published in the GCVE distribution directory, available at:  [https://gcve.eu/dist/](https://gcve.eu/dist/)

![GCVE.eu logo](https://gcve.eu/logos/gcve.png)

## GCVE GNA Directory File `gcve.json`

GCVE Numbering Authorities (GNAs) are independent entities that can allocate identifiers without relying on a centralised block distribution system or rigid policy enforcement.

If you would like to obtain a GNA identifier, see [Eligibility and Process to Obtain a GNA ID](https://gcve.eu/about/#eligibility-and-process-to-obtain-a-gna-id).

## GCVE UUID References `references.json`

This file contains UUID references used by the GCVE ecosystem across the different [Best Current Practice (BCP) standards](https://gcve.eu/bcp/).

### `kev` prefix (GCVE-BCP-07)

GCVE manages a list of UUIDs that are used as source references in the [GCVE-BCP-07 Known Exploited Vulnerability (KEV) Assertion](https://gcve.eu/bcp/gcve-bcp-07/) format.
